text:
**Target us-gaap/Revenues**
- **Gap:** Series ends 2015-01-31; request expects 2025-10-26. No data beyond 2015.
- **Restatement:** FY2013-14 shifted from $72.596B to $71.279B (-$1.317B).
- **Duplicate:** Quarterly 2009-2010 rows appear across multiple 10-K/10-Q filings, inflating counts.

**Ford us-gaap/Revenues**
- **Gap:** Series ends 2024-12-31 ($184.992T); request expects period >= 2025-10-26. No later data filed.
- **Status:** Latest period confirmed from 10-K filed 2025-02-06.

**Target RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax**
- **Gap:** Starts 2016-01-31; hole between end of Revenues (2015-01-31) and start of new concept. No 2015 bridge data.

**Verdict:** Refine required. Both revenue series are truncated before the requested end date; Target has restatement/duplicate issues; Ford lacks post-2024 data.
